toolprompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: horizontal character turnaround sheet for a game art reference
Input image 1 is the approved Sera character design and the only visual reference. Preserve Sera exactly: petite adult healer, sakura-pink fluffy short hair with small side braid and cream ribbon, timid gentle round eyes and uncertain smile, simple white priestly robe with cream/gold trim, long pale-gold stole, brown belt and simple brown boots, colors and bold simple anime-manga cel style.
Create one wide horizontal sheet with exactly THREE full-body drawings of the same Sera, equally spaced left to right, identical scale, same head-top and foot-bottom baseline:
1) FRONT: strict 0-degree front-facing neutral standing view.
2) SIDE: strict 90-degree true side profile facing toward the RIGHT side of the sheet. The nose, chest, toes point right; back of head is left. No three-quarter.
3) BACK: strict 180-degree rear view.
Neutral turnaround pose: arms slightly away from torso and naturally lowered, hands relaxed or modestly together, feet parallel, no dramatic action pose and no exaggerated T-pose. Preserve the small braid, ribbon, stole, robe trim and belt placement through rotation. Back view should be a restrained logical continuation of the approved robe, without invented decoration or equipment. All three figures same height scale, full hair and feet visible, generous spacing.
Background: flat white to warm ivory, no perspective, no dramatic light, no large ground shadows. Add only small English labels FRONT, SIDE, BACK below the corresponding figures. No other text, no name, no watermark. Avoid any 3/4 angle, extra figures, child/chibi proportions, weapon, cropped head or feet.
